name: background_jobs
sql:
CREATE TABLE background_jobs (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	queue_position BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, 
	kind VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	coalesce_key VARCHAR(64), 
	state VARCHAR(24) DEFAULT 'queued' NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT timezone('UTC', now()) NOT NULL, 
	started_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	finished_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	owner_generation INTEGER, 
	attempt_generation INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	initialized_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	schedule_key VARCHAR(128), 
	schedule_revision INTEGER, 
	occurrence_id UUID, 
	scheduled_for TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	result JSONB, 
	error_code VARCHAR(40), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_background_jobs_kind CHECK (kind IN ('news_processing', 'news_digest', 'telegram_digest', 'backup', 'reprocess_failed', 'article_reprocess', 'summaries_generate', 'source_test')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_background_jobs_state CHECK (state IN ('queued', 'running', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'interrupted', 'delivery_unknown')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_background_jobs_error_code CHECK (error_code IS NULL OR error_code IN ('worker_error', 'worker_interrupted', 'worker_recovery_exhausted', 'external_outcome_unknown', 'invalid_job', 'resource_limit', 'database_unavailable')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_background_jobs_payload_object CHECK (jsonb_typeof(payload) = 'object'), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_background_jobs_result_object CHECK (result IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(result) = 'object'), 
	UNIQUE (queue_position), 
	UNIQUE (idempotency_key)
)

name: idx_background_jobs_active_coalesce
sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_background_jobs_active_coalesce ON background_jobs (coalesce_key) WHERE state IN ('queued', 'running', 'interrupted') AND coalesce_key IS NOT NULL

name: article_ingestion_runs

CREATE TABLE article_ingestion_runs (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	job_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	attempt_generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	envelope_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	owner_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	worker_generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	backend_pid INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	executor_instance_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	deadline_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'running' NOT NULL, 
	started_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT timezone('UTC', now()) NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT timezone('UTC', now()) NOT NULL, 
	finished_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	result JSONB DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL, 
	error_code VARCHAR(40), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (job_id, attempt_generation), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_ingestion_run_attempt_positive CHECK (attempt_generation > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_ingestion_run_worker_generation_positive CHECK (worker_generation > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_ingestion_run_backend_pid_positive CHECK (backend_pid > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_ingestion_run_digest_length CHECK (length(envelope_sha256) = 64), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_ingestion_run_state CHECK (state IN ('running','succeeded','failed','cancelled','interrupted')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_ingestion_run_result_object CHECK (jsonb_typeof(result) = 'object'), 
	FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES background_jobs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

name: background_job_executions
sql:
CREATE TABLE background_job_executions (
	job_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	attempt_generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	envelope_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	executor_instance_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	owner_id UUID, 
	worker_generation INTEGER, 
	deadline_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	state VARCHAR(24) DEFAULT 'accepted' NOT NULL, 
	accepted_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT timezone('UTC', now()) NOT NULL, 
	started_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	finished_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	result JSONB, 
	error_code VARCHAR(40), 
	legacy_completion_applied_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	legacy_alert_state VARCHAR(16), 
	PRIMARY KEY (job_id, attempt_generation), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_background_execution_attempt_generation CHECK (attempt_generation >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_background_execution_hash CHECK (length(envelope_sha256) = 64), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_background_execution_generation CHECK (worker_generation IS NULL OR worker_generation > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_background_execution_state CHECK (state IN ('accepted', 'running', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'interrupted', 'delivery_unknown')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_background_execution_error_code CHECK (error_code IS NULL OR error_code IN ('worker_error', 'worker_interrupted', 'worker_recovery_exhausted', 'external_outcome_unknown', 'invalid_job', 'resource_limit', 'database_unavailable')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_background_execution_result_object CHECK (result IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(result) = 'object'), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_background_execution_alert_state CHECK (legacy_alert_state IS NULL OR legacy_alert_state IN ('pending', 'attempting', 'delivered', 'unknown', 'not_needed')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES background_jobs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

name: source_collection_state
sql:
CREATE TABLE source_collection_state (
	source_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	config_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	scan_limit INTEGER DEFAULT '20' NOT NULL, 
	cursor_offset INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	scan_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT 'false' NOT NULL, 
	previous_hashes JSONB DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL, 
	scan_hashes JSONB DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL, 
	acknowledged_hashes JSONB DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL, 
	snapshot_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	content_sha256 VARCHAR(64), 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT timezone('UTC', now()) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (source_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_source_collection_scan_limit CHECK (scan_limit BETWEEN 1 AND 100), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_source_collection_cursor CHECK (cursor_offset BETWEEN 0 AND 100), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_source_collection_cursor_within_limit CHECK (cursor_offset <= scan_limit), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_source_collection_hash_objects CHECK (jsonb_typeof(previous_hashes) = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof(scan_hashes) = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof(acknowledged_hashes) = 'object'), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_source_collection_digest_length CHECK (length(config_sha256) = 64), 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_id) REFERENCES sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

name: article_ingestion_source_runs
sql:
CREATE TABLE article_ingestion_source_runs (
	run_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	source_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	config_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL, 
	candidates INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	saved INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	updated INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	skipped INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	fetched_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	error_code VARCHAR(40), 
	selector_study_sha256 VARCHAR(64), 
	PRIMARY KEY (run_id, source_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_ingestion_source_type CHECK (source_type IN ('rss','telegram','custom')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_ingestion_source_state CHECK (state IN ('pending','running','succeeded','partial','failed','skipped','busy','deferred','resource_limit','unavailable')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_ingestion_source_counts_nonnegative CHECK (candidates >= 0 AND saved >= 0 AND updated >= 0 AND skipped >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_ingestion_source_digest_length CHECK (length(config_sha256) = 64), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES article_ingestion_runs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
